Read-only research task against Jira (zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net, project key SFCC). Do NOT modify/create anything. If mcp__mcp-atlassian__jira_* tools are deferred, load via ToolSearch: "select:mcp__mcp-atlassian__jira_search,mcp__mcp-atlassian__jira_get_issue".

CONTEXT: There is an open design disagreement about a rule in a TSD (Confluence 346783750, section 5.5) splitting Contentful-consuming components into "Studio Experience" components (used inside Contentful's drag-and-drop "Experience Builder", currently scoped to Z.immerse (SFCC-10, Squad-B epic) and campaign/marketing landing pages) versus "coded content-type components" (hand-built, for fixed slots in commerce templates: homepage, footer, nav, PLP, PDP). Tim Lavelle (Solution Architect) commented: "I'm not sure we need to separate these and the components we build will most of the time being used in an experience builder" and "Authors will place elements on a page" — suggesting he may want most/all components to go through the Experience Builder rather than keeping a two-path split.

TASK: Search Jira project SFCC exhaustively for ANY clue about the intended direction — i.e., whether there's a ticket, epic, comment, or requirement anywhere indicating the Experience Builder is meant to be used broadly (beyond just Z.immerse/campaign pages) for things like footer, nav, homepage modules, PLP inserts, PDP tabs.

Specifically check:
1. jira_search for text ~ "Experience Builder" OR text ~ "Studio Experience" OR text ~ "experience builder" OR text ~ "component library" OR text ~ "flexible component" OR text ~ "visual editor" OR text ~ "page composition", across ALL issue types, no status filter.
2. Re-fetch SFCC-10 "Z.immerse" in FULL (all fields + all comments) — does its scope, comments, or any linked issue suggest expansion beyond Z.immerse/campaign pages to other page types (homepage, footer, nav, PLP, PDP)?
3. Search for any comments by Tim Lavelle (author field or mentions) across Contentful-labelled tickets (label ~ "Contentful") that discuss component-building strategy, authoring approach, or "most components" / "all components" language.
4. Check the Sprint-1 content-type stories (SFCC-51, SFCC-55, SFCC-90, SFCC-58, SFCC-94, SFCC-96 — footer/nav/homepage) for any description or comment suggesting they should be built as Experience Builder components rather than coded components.
5. Check SFCC-249 (the TSD review ticket) comments in full for any additional Tim comments beyond what's already known that touch on this topic.
6. Search broadly: jira_search jql="project = SFCC AND text ~ \"experience\"" ORDER BY created DESC, and scan results for anything relevant (not just Z.immerse) — filter out irrelevant noise (e.g. "user experience" in unrelated contexts) but flag anything substantive.
7. Check if there's any card about migrating/consolidating the existing coded components (heroBanner, duplexSection, productHero, videoEmbed) into Experience Builder registrations.

Report back ONLY concrete findings with issue-key + exact quote/evidence. If a search turns up nothing relevant to this FUTURE-DIRECTION question, say so explicitly rather than padding with tangential matches. Do not speculate about what Tim "probably" means — only report what is actually written somewhere.

content.text:
## Findings: Jira search for Experience Builder / Studio Experience direction (project SFCC)

**One clear, direct hit. Everything else came back empty or off-topic.**

### 1. The strongest piece of evidence: SFCC-51 (Promotional Announcement Banner UI)

Tim Lavelle, comment dated 2026-07-07 (comment id 13363):

> "For this being a Contenful managed element, the team needs to do a Technical Solution Design and POC on how we integrate the Business Manager properties to Contenful and call those on the component rendering. **As this will be a component in the Contenful Studio builder, users can drag-n-drop where this lives on specific pages, but if this is going to live on a PLP and/or PDP or Global across all but Zimmerse, then will likely need a configuration to target specific SFCC Category IDs and Product IDs.**"

This is significant because the Promotional Announcement Banner is explicitly **not** a Z.immerse/campaign-page component — per its own description it displays "on Home / PDP / PLP, but it does not on Z.immerse." Tim is describing it as a Studio-builder (Experience Builder), drag-and-drop component anyway. This is the one concrete instance in Jira where Tim ties Studio/Experience-Builder placement to a component living on PLP, PDP, or "Global across all but Zimmerse" — i.e., outside the Z.immerse/campaign scope.

This carried through into the accepted AC (Tim, comment 13387, same ticket):

> "Given the promotional banner is placed on a **PDP or PLP via Contentful Studio**, when it is configured with one or more SFCC Category IDs and/or Product IDs, then the banner is only displayed when the shopper is viewing a matching category or product page."

So the "via Contentful Studio" placement language for a PDP/PLP/global component made it into the story's actual acceptance criteria, not just a comment aside.

### 2. SFCC-10 (Z.immerse epic) — re-fetched in full, no expansion signal

Full description and all fields checked. Scope is explicitly self-contained: "Immersive editorial landing page template," "Flexible content component library for editorial page composition," direct-link campaign/marketing pages. No comments exist on the epic itself, and nothing in its Dependencies (SFCC-2, SFCC-3, Contentful) or elsewhere suggests the epic's scope was meant to expand to homepage, footer, nav, PLP, or PDP. It reads as bounded to Z.immerse/campaign use.

### 3. Sprint-1 content-type stories (SFCC-51, 55, 90, 58, 94, 96) — no Experience Builder signal except SFCC-51

- **SFCC-55** (Global Footer UI): comments are sign-off/copy notes only (Jasmijn, re: rollover state, copyright alignment). Nothing on Studio/Experience Builder.
- **SFCC-90** (Homepage Layout & Content Modules UI): one comment (Jasmijn) about needing design flexibility on fixed 4-tile rows. No Studio/Experience Builder mention.
- **SFCC-58** (Home Page Contentful Integration): placeholder story, no comments.
- **SFCC-94** (Homepage Content Row — Flexible Grid & Carousel): no comments at all.
- **SFCC-96** (Desktop Mega Menu): Tim's comment asks about CMS-managed content and requests accessibility/keyboard nav review — no mention of Studio/Experience Builder or drag-and-drop.
- **SFCC-51**: covered above — the one hit.

### 4. SFCC-249 (TSD review ticket) — full comment thread checked, nothing new

All three comments are from Marcel Angelo Navarro and Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz. Marcel's review references several prior Tim asks (locale count, Sprint-2 authoring session, PLP inline grid/pagination, MRT-apps split, New Relic, product imagery ownership, cache degradation) but none of these threads touch the Studio Experience vs. coded-component split.

### 5. Broad "Experience Builder" / "Studio Experience" / "component library" / "flexible component" / "visual editor" / "page composition" text search — no other hits

Only SFCC-10, SFCC-2 (PWA Kit Components — a *code* component library, unrelated to Contentful Studio), and SFCC-51 surfaced, plus generic noise (product-attribute stories, PLP editorial-block stories that use "flexible/configurable" only in the sense of PWA component reuse across pages — e.g. SFCC-251: "this component should be configurable to appear on different pages or positions... if the merchandiser wants this on home page they should be able to reuse this component there" — but this is about PWA-side component reusability, not Contentful Studio placement, and Tim is not the author of that line).

### 6. Broad `text ~ "experience"` search (30 results, all scanned) — no additional hits

Result set was epics and stories where "experience" appears as ordinary English ("elevated digital experience," "brand experience," "customer experience," motion design epic, client services epic, etc.). Nothing else referencing Experience Builder as a platform capability.

### 7. Migration of existing coded components (heroBanner, duplexSection, productHero, videoEmbed) into Experience Builder registrations — nothing found

Direct text search for these component names plus "migrate," "register component," "component registration" returned no matches. The only place `productHero.tsx` is mentioned is **SFCC-238** (Spike: Contentful-to-PWA Kit Product/Category ID Rendering), which references it purely as an existing technical bridge pattern (`useProduct` hook wiring, SSR vs. client-side rendering) to be documented/reconciled — there is no language there about migrating it into Experience Builder. No card exists for this at all.

### 8. Author search for Tim Lavelle comments

JQL doesn't support filtering by comment author directly (no ScriptRunner), and `comment ~ "Lavelle"` returned 0 (his name doesn't appear as literal comment text). I instead pulled full comment threads on every Contentful-labelled ticket, the Z.immerse epic, the two TSD tickets (SFCC-123, SFCC-249), the mega-menu/footer/header/nav stories, and SFCC-238. Tim's comments turned up on SFCC-51 (the Studio Builder quote above), SFCC-96, SFCC-97, and SFCC-52 — all standard refinement/accessibility/scope-splitting feedback, none touching the Experience Builder scope question except SFCC-51.

## Bottom line

There is exactly **one** concrete Jira artifact suggesting Experience Builder use beyond Z.immerse/campaign pages: **Tim Lavelle's comment and the resulting AC on SFCC-51**, describing the Promotional Announcement Banner (a component that lives on PLP/PDP/Global, not Z.immerse) as "a component in the Contenful Studio builder" placed via drag-and-drop. No other ticket, epic, comment, or requirement in the SFCC project discusses footer, nav, homepage modules, or PDP tabs going through Experience Builder — those areas (SFCC-55, 90, 94, 96, 117) are silent on the question. I'm not speculating beyond this: whether Tim intends this pattern to generalize to all coded components is not stated anywhere in Jira; SFCC-51 is the only data point.
